instrument: pnpm lab:paddle-waterfall (replays the real pipeline stages against the same 40 labeled frames)
datasetVersion: pickle-real-v0.1 + rally2 + afn-vic (5 cases, 3 sources, 27 visible labels)
headline: 74 of the 78 lost recall points die in ONE stage: ownership + primary selection (S2 0.96 -> S3/S4 0.22). Detection and temporal association are effectively solved at this corpus size.
rootCausesIdentified: A: DUPLICATE PLAYER TRACKS — Vision emits overlapping detections of the same human, so the tracker produced duplicates of the TARGET (afn-sasebo-rally1: P9 at torso-distance 0.058, P13 at 0.068). Those duplicates were fed to ownership as 'other players', putting the target's own wrist on the opposing side of every comparison. FIXED (track-level torso-coincidence suppression + wrist-level same-hand suppression in otherPlayersWrists).

B: TRACK FRAGMENTATION + WRONG SELECTION CRITERION — the true paddle's detections are split across many short tracks (afn-vic-rally1: 26 candidate tracks; seven each covered one labeled frame; none covered both). Selection scores by windowCoverage x detectorScore, which favors long-lived BACKGROUND racket-like tracks (winner T3: 0 label hits; T6: 97% coverage, 0 hits). NOT FIXED.

attemptedFixRejected.change: hand-affinity-dominant rescoring (fraction of observations within 0.13 of a target wrist) + affinity eligibility gate
attemptedFixRejected.result: S4 recall 0.22 -> 0.04 — MEASURED WORSE, reverted immediately
attemptedFixRejected.interpretation: Target wrist positions are themselves unreliable at the labeled moments, so wrist proximity cannot carry the selection decision alone. Fragment MERGING (before selection) is the indicated next attack, not rescoring.

nextAttack: 1. Merge paddle fragments belonging to one physical paddle before selection (appearance + motion continuity across the 250ms gap limit), then re-measure the waterfall.
2. Only then revisit the selection criterion.
3. Ownership needs the 20+ dual-paddle labels to be trainable rather than hand-designed.
unchangedBaselines: No frozen benchmark numbers were altered; end-to-end paddle P/R remains as previously reported.
